name: ai-suggestion-shield
description: One shortcut to suppress inline AI ghost text and common AI coding assistant suggestions in VS Code.

commands.title: AI Suggestion Shield: Stop AI Suggestions
AI Suggestion Shield: Restore AI Suggestions
AI Suggestion Shield: Toggle AI Suggestions

aiSuggestionShield.autoStopOnStartup.description: Automatically stop inline and common AI assistant suggestions when VS Code starts.

aiSuggestionShield.showStatusBar.description: Show a status bar control for toggling AI Suggestion Shield.

aiSuggestionShield.targetScope.description: Where AI Suggestion Shield writes suppression settings. Global affects all workspaces; workspace affects only the current workspace.

scripts.test:syntax: node --check src/extension.js && node --check scripts/run-vscode-tests.js && node --check test/suite/index.js
